title: refactor: compress the codemod facade stubs in engine.ts and protocol.ts — one shared host per facet instead of a per-call host literal (body-identical; about 1,000 lines off engine.ts)
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: the maintainer asked for this on PR #30012 at 2026-11-04T10:03Z (「我觉得文件还是太长，还有进一步的拆分优化空间吗」「可以后续立卡处理」「合并之后再继续」). The facades are merged: engine.ts as 237f5137 (#30012) and protocol.ts as 48914fdc (#29998). Estimates come from the #29986 / #29985 dev reports. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane (devx or server).

Business reason: the 161 `ObjectQL` facade stubs are about 1,500 lines today. Each one builds its own host literal for the facet call. A single shared host per facet (built once, on the facade) keeps every body byte-identical and takes about 1,000 lines off `engine.ts`. The same shape applies to the 85 `ProtocolHandler` stubs in `protocol.ts`.
Reader who acts: whoever owns `scripts/codemod-split-engine.mjs` / `scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs`.

## What to do
- Change the codemods, regenerate, and re-run the same proofs the splits ran: byte-identity, determinism, public `.d.ts` EQUAL, suites at base counts, and the #30019 gate green.
- One PR per file, each landing in its own short freeze window with the maintainer's approval if it is over 3000 lines.
Dedupe: `facade stub host`, `codemod-split-engine`. The nearest are #29465 (the programme), #30019 and #30020. **New.**
